title: Milestones throughout HARIBO’s unique success story
content: Big Goldbear in front of the headquarter in Grafschaft. Quality check for the HARIBO Goldbears. ## 100 years of HARIBO, from a home kitchen to a global market leader. As a family business in its third generation, we celebrated our 100 year anniversary in 2020 and 100 Years of Goldbears in 2022. Born in the town of Friesdorf near Bonn, Germany in 1893, Hans Riegel trains to be a confectioner and becomes a partner in the Heinen & Riegel company. He founds HARIBO (HAns RIegel BOnn) on December 13th, 1920 and launches his sweets production at a home kitchen with nothing more than a sack of sugar, a marble slab, a stool, a stove, a copper pot and a rolling pin. His wife Gertrud becomes the company’s first employee in 1921. Hans Riegel lays the foundation for HARIBO’s success when he invents the DANCING BEAR – a gummi bear that would one day become world-famous as the iconic HARIBO Goldbear.
